measurement_scope: Predeclared local representation checks on our two artifacts and one deliberately damaged copy; no reference-art metric and no claim of visual attention or aesthetic acceptance.
quantization: PNG RGB greys nearest to 64,136,208; antialias extra greys counted separately; RGB is not CIELAB L.
area_test: Report all three quantized area fractions; no pass threshold for global area.
threshold_reason: 5% excludes a token speck of either extreme in the premarked ROI; 144 is the fixed palette endpoint span. Lost-edge sample is intentionally a same-value join, so any quantized adjacent step violates this narrow representation claim. None of these are source-artist numerical laws.
